about:
Country Furniture Warehouse, operating as Crofton Furniture Warehouse, has been a fixture on Defense Highway in Gambrills, Maryland for over 25 years. The family-owned retailer occupies a showroom at 1655 Defense Highway, where it has served the Crofton community since its founding, though the exact year is not publicly stated.

The business specializes in selling solid-wood furniture for every room in the house, with a particular emphasis on Amish-crafted pieces. Its inventory spans kitchen, dining, bedroom, and living room collections, all sourced directly from Amish workshops rather than produced in-house. The showroom operates Tuesday through Saturday from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., with most Sundays open from 12 p.m. to 4 p.m., and remains closed on Mondays.

The customer base is almost entirely residential, drawing shoppers from Crofton and neighboring areas in Anne Arundel County. The company does not advertise commercial, hospitality, or contract furnishings accounts, and its marketing focuses on local foot traffic and word-of-mouth referrals.

What sets the operation apart, according to its own description, is the combination of family ownership and a direct supply line to Amish builders, which it promotes as offering quality wood furniture without intermediary markups. The website, built on the Homestead platform, reinforces this local, direct-to-consumer positioning.
